documents.title: Extra Ordinary General Meeting ('EOGM') Of The Members Of U. Y. Fincorp Limited Will Be Held On Wednesday, The 25Th Day Of November, 2026 At 11:00 A.M.

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for FY 2025-26, driven by higher revenue from operations and total income, alongside an expanded lending portfolio. The company diversified its product offerings by introducing Equipment Financing under the "GrowU.money" brand and expanding into small ticket-size loans through a joint venture brand "FUNDOBABA". The leadership emphasized continued focus on asset quality, prudent risk management, liquidity, and operational efficiency amid an evolving economic and regulatory environment. Furthermore, the company maintained adequate internal financial controls and complied with applicable Reserve Bank of India norms. U.Y.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Indian economy maintained strong economic resilience and growth momentum during FY 2025-26, supported by domestic consumption, investment activity, manufacturing, and services.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian economy maintained strong growth momentum during FY 2025-26, supported by domestic consumption, investment activity, manufacturing and services.

demand_outlook.claim: The company views the growing financing requirements of businesses and individuals, increasing financial inclusion, digital adoption, and formalisation of economic activity as providing a strong foundation for the future.
demand_outlook.quote: The growing financing requirements of businesses and individuals, increasing financial inclusion, digital adoption and the continuing formalisation of economic activity provide a strong foundation for the future of financial intermediation.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the predicted slowdown in GDP growth is aligned to pervasive global uncertainty.
demand_outlook.quote: The predicted slowdown in growth is aligned to the pervasive uncertainty in the global economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the business outlook is very exciting.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook of the business is very exciting and we take it as an opportunity to do something unique and exceptional.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among MSMEs and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.
demand_outlook.quote: As the country progresses, demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its lending portfolio to ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, compared with ₹27,457.34 Lakhs as at March 31, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Our lending portfolio also expanded meaningfully during the year, reaching ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, compared with ₹27,457.34 Lakhs as at March 31, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a contractual joint venture agreement with Fintech Cloud Private Limited to expand into small ticket-size personal and business loans under the brand name "FUNDOBABA".
capex_expansion.quote: During the period under review, the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: The company introduced Equipment Financing under the "GrowU.money" brand during FY 2025-26 to support the acquisition of equipment and productive assets.
capex_expansion.quote: During FY 2025–26, the Company further diversified its product portfolio by introducing Equipment Financing under the “GrowU.money” brand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened a new branch office at Lucknow for business expansion under the brand name GrowU.Money.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 3rd May, 2024 inter alia considered and approved the proposal of opening of the Company’s new branch office at Lucknow for the purpose of expansion of its business operation in the area of Lucknow under the brand name “GrowU.Money”.

capex_expansion.claim: The company started its loan against property product operations in fiscal 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The LAP product operations were started in Fiscal 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria, and Gorakhpur regions.
capex_expansion.quote: Since GrowU has received positive response under its pilot project in the areas of lucknow and Kanpur, it is now inter alia expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria and Gorakhpur regions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is set to launch a new product involving loans against property.
capex_expansion.quote: To further diversify its offerings, the Company is set to launch a new product – loans against property.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased to ₹16,164.13 Lakhs for the year ended March 31, 2026, compared to ₹11,104.61 Lakhs in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, the Company achieved Revenue from Operations of ₹16,164.13 Lakhs, as against ₹11,104.61 Lakhs in the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Profit Before Tax increased substantially to ₹6,664.38 Lakhs for FY 2025-26 compared with ₹1,693.88 Lakhs in FY 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: Profit Before Tax increased substantially to ₹6,664.38 Lakhs, compared with ₹1,693.88 Lakhs in FY 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: The small-ticket sized loans digitalized by the company carry an interest rate ranging between 24-33% p.a.
margins_costs.quote: The Company has also digitalized the onboarding disbusrement process of small ticket sized Loan with the monthly run rate of approx Rs. 100 Lakhs with an interest rate ranging between 24-33% p.a.

orders_capacity.claim: The company disbursed loans to more than 3,800 customers across customer locations in Uttar Pradesh through its network of 2 branches and 6 Business Correspondents.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company had disbursed loan to more than 3,800 customers, across more than 2 Customer Locations in Uttar Pradesh, through its network of 2 branches, & 6 Business Correspondents.

orders_capacity.claim: The company built a loan portfolio exceeding 14 crore INR in just one year.
orders_capacity.quote: In just one year, Company has built a loan portfolio exceeding 14 crore INR keeping the NPA rate below 2 percent.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, in order to plough back resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors of your Company do not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026 in order to plough back the resources for future growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the operating environment remains competitive and subject to evolving regulations, credit risks, interest-rate movements, and broader economic cycle changes.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, we also recognise that the operating environment will remain competitive and subject to evolving regulations, credit risks, interest-rate movements and changes in the broader economic cycle.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that advanced economies experienced slower growth due to high interest rates and weakened consumer spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: While advanced economies like the U.S. and the Eurozone experienced slower growth due to high interest rates and weakened consumer spending, emerging markets, particularly in Asia, maintained better economic momentum, driven by domestic demand and technology sector growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that trade tariff measures implemented by the US administration heightened uncertainties surrounding the global economic outlook.
risks_headwinds.quote: These trade tariff measures have heightened uncertainties surrounding the global economic outlook, creating additional challenges for growth and inflation across regions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global GDP growth is expected to remain low at 3% for 2024 due to geopolitical conflicts, elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions, and elections.
risks_headwinds.quote: Multiple factors like the on-going geopolitical conflicts, wide-spread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions and elections in many parts of the world continue to contribute to the uncertainty of the Global Economic Outlook. Encouragingly, inflation has softened over the highs of the previous year and is expected to continue to moderate. Global GDP growth is expected to remain low at 3% for 2024.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its operations in existing markets, selectively enter newer geographies, and explore organic and inorganic opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to build upon our existing strengths by expanding our operations in existing markets, selectively entering newer geographies and exploring organic as well as inorganic opportunities, while remaining within our risk appetite.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to focus on strengthening asset quality, maintaining adequate liquidity, improving operational efficiency, diversifying products, and expanding customer reach.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to focus on strengthening our asset quality, maintaining adequate liquidity, improving operational efficiency, diversifying our products and expanding our customer reach.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.
management_commitments.quote: The Company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans for an automate tech platform for mobile-based loans for instant credit.
management_commitments.quote: Under the guidance of Mr. Udai Kothari, being the Managing Director of the Company, we are planning for an Automate tech platform for Mobile based loan for instant credit and entered into the new segments of financing like equipment financing, corporate tie-up and Instant Credit.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to expand its business in all the areas of financing and related activities.
management_commitments.quote: The Company is taking steps to expand its business in all the areas of financing and related activities.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to enter new geographical markets and diversify service offerings.
management_commitments.quote: Plans to enter new geographical markets and diversify service offerings are likely to open up new revenue streams.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
